title: Ink & Voice artistic touch and wash audit
user_quote: Audit for artistic touch and wash for the home page, edition page etc
scope: Audit of current local sources across 15 representative routes, shared art/wash styles and selected saved visual evidence. No new design approval inferred.
reviewer: Current chat assistant; Drishti review role with Samanta source inspection; same-assistant review
summary: The visual foundation is coherent and deliberately clean. Artistic emphasis should remain in covers, portraits and poem-related illustrations. Two current source inconsistencies are actionable: old fixed colours in small ornaments and English editorial headings using Literata. A localized homepage panel-edge wash is an optional refinement.

findings.title: Small decorative marks retain the previous palette
findings.observation: The waterline has fixed rust #983e30, slate #263d4b and olive #65665d. The restored inline header separator contains #963F28 and #78643A. These colours bypass the Ink & Voice mulberry/rose tokens. The content waterline is referenced by poet openings, quiet-reader titles and edition contents; utility openings suppress it intentionally. Current browser appearance has not been reverified.
findings.recommendation: Retain the established shapes and placement. Make decorative strokes respond to Ink & Voice light/dark colours through scoped styles or a theme-aware delivery of the existing vector. Preserve the historical SVG originals and do not recolour cover paintings, portraits or the original logo.

findings.title: English edition-editorial headings use the prose font
findings.observation: #main .editorial-prose h2 uses var(--serif), now Literata. Its ID specificity wins over the general Newsreader heading selector. This makes the English editorial subheadings an exception to the current website display-type rule. Odia/Hindi have explicit script-family rules and must remain intact.
findings.recommendation: Use the approved display family for English editorial headings, preserving script-specific Odia/Hindi overrides, then inspect actual wrapping. No need to change magazine-cover mastheads.

findings.title: Homepage featured-poem panel could have a more tactile edge
findings.observation: The featured poem is defined as a flat, rectangular soft-rose panel. The current-edition section has straight rules and a clean page background. This follows the approved clean-surface design; it is not a broken or missing wash. The current homepage layout has not been freshly rendered in this audit.
findings.recommendation: Preview one faint rose/mulberry wash restricted to the outer edge or empty margin of the poem panel. Leave verse and language controls on an even surface. Keep the complete current-edition cover as the homepage image and sharing image. Avoid a second atmospheric illustration, global texture, random motifs or wash behind every section. This is a proposal, not an approved implementation.

findings.title: Two sampled pages repeat a stylesheet link
findings.observation: Both pages include article-engagement.css twice. This does not create a doubled wash or double the CSS effect. It is ancillary source cleanup, not an artistic defect.
findings.recommendation: Remove duplicate emission in its responsible generator during a later approved maintenance pass; preserve active engagement behaviour.

page_matrix.assessment: The current edition is the right artistic anchor. Featured poetry rotates independently. The main panel is intentionally flat rose.
page_matrix.recommendation: Keep the cover and compact header. Preview a restrained edge wash on the featured-poem area only.
page_matrix.evidence_level: Current source; no fresh homepage rendering.

page_matrix.assessment: The full cover, its story, poet portraits and contents already give the issue a distinct identity. Current edition editorial includes nine vignette figures.
page_matrix.recommendation: Preserve cover art. Harmonize small marks; correct the English editorial heading family. Avoid another full-page wash competing with the cover.
page_matrix.evidence_level: Current sources for issues 48/47; earlier issue-48 dark screenshot reviewed.

page_matrix.assessment: The ordinary page has a clean background. Quiet-reader leaves use cotton paper at 2.5% opacity; dark mode explicitly hides that layer.
page_matrix.recommendation: Keep sustained reading quiet and stable. Match the existing small opening ornament to the palette; leave verse backgrounds even.
page_matrix.evidence_level: Current poem/reader CSS plus earlier desktop light reader screenshot.

page_matrix.assessment: Watercolour portraits supply the artistic colour. Profile framing is restrained paper, thin border and mulberry edge.
page_matrix.recommendation: Retain portraits and breathing room; no extra decorative wash behind biography. Harmonize the existing small waterline.
page_matrix.evidence_level: Current profile/team source plus earlier profile screenshot.

page_matrix.assessment: Text-led openings intentionally omit old decorative banners/waterlines; covers and portraits provide visual interest.
page_matrix.recommendation: Keep search and browsing clear. Do not restore a wash to every directory opening. Retain the archive-only footer boat.
page_matrix.evidence_level: Current source; fresh mobile/dark appearance pending.

page_matrix.assessment: The essay has a relevant editorial image, generous text column and restrained captions. The article image is distinct from the homepage’s current-cover requirement.
page_matrix.recommendation: Keep article art tied to its subject; use quiet section spacing instead of decorative panels behind prose.
page_matrix.evidence_level: Current source plus earlier essay screenshot; About source only.

page_matrix.assessment: Practical text-led openings follow the approved restraint rule.
page_matrix.recommendation: Keep fields and actions on flat high-contrast surfaces; no decorative wash around form controls.

confirmed_preserve: Current complete edition cover as homepage and root sharing image
Original poem selection rotation and exact poem wording
Cover mastheads in Cormorant, independent of website Newsreader
Existing paintings, portrait identities, artwork provenance and credits
Flat utility/forms; restrained light reader paper and no dark reader texture
Reader services, consent and release gates
ruled_out: Historical cotton-paper/monsoon-wash body classes do not mean visible wash: Ink & Voice disables the body pseudo-element.

Old Cormorant declarations in language-essay.css do not establish a current heading leak: the stronger shared heading selector sets Newsreader for English. The ID-based edition-editorial selector is the actual exception.

The footer asset is transparent, not an opaque cream rectangle. Diagnostic primary-colour fringe pixels had no alpha above 32/255; the local image viewer alone is not evidence of a visible browser fringe. Fresh light/dark footer rendering is still pending.
Magazine cover cream page edges are part of the approved physical cover treatment, not a reason to recolour the cover artwork.
limitations: Browser inspection was attempted twice; both calls were not executed because automatic approval review reported: Selected model is at capacity. This is an infrastructure review failure, not an unsafe-action determination. No alternate browser route was used.

Saved screenshots from earlier on 19 October were directly inspected for edition, profile, essay and reader treatment. They predate the compact-header restoration/current-edition homepage revision and are not proof of the current header or homepage layout.

This is a source-based artistic audit with selected historical visual evidence, not a fresh full-site visual, accessibility, interaction or publication certification. No current computed-style measurements or mobile screenshots were obtained.
No site implementation, artwork, source poetry, service settings, publication or design rules were changed. Optional wash remains a proposal.
next_visual_checks: Current homepage at desktop/phone widths, including different featured-poem lengths
Issue 48 and 47 opening/contents/editorial in light and dark
Profile and archive footer against both page colours
Any proposed wash at full size, reduced motion and print; no reading contrast loss

checklist.scope: Read-only audit of existing page families; no new page or design-rule change.
checklist.artwork: Existing full covers, portraits, decorations and reader texture inspected in source; selected saved screenshots and footer asset viewed directly.
checklist.typography: Two palette/type consistency findings recorded with exact selectors.
checklist.delivery: No site build rerun needed because no implementation changed. Previous test results are not represented as this audit’s results.

subsequent_resolution.note: User approved this audit in the same chat. Implementation and fresh browser evidence are recorded separately; this original audit and its historical limitations remain unchanged.
